label: ID
description: Unique short name (lowercase, no spaces); used in share links

label: Name
description: Full name as shown in the app (brand, model and variant)

label: Model
description: Model without brand and variant (e.g. Seal); variants of one model sit together in the car list. Blank = the name

label: Variant
description: Version of the model (e.g. low, high, ER); blank = the base version

label: Market
description: Code of the market the price applies to, from data/markets.csv (e.g. TH). One row per car per market; blank = listed only under All markets

label: Currency
description: Currency of price and the cost overrides (THB, EUR, …)

label: Price
description: Purchase price in the car's currency

label: Powertrain
description: BEV = battery electric. ICE cars are modelled like an EV (approximation, as in the spreadsheet)

label: Body type
description: Selects default drag coefficient and frontal area when those are missing (see body_types.csv)

label: Car class
description: Onboard electronics (incl. driver-assistance computer) and cabin size for heating/AC, see data/onboard/classes.csv

label: Battery capacity
description: Usable (net) capacity where the source gives it (EV Database), else the maker's figure (Chinese makers usually state the usable capacity)

label: Capacity at the rated cycles
description: Capacity left when the rated cycles are used up (% of nominal), as the maker states it with the cycles. Blank = assumption (80 %)

label: Battery type
description: Cell chemistry; selects the temperature-dependent discharge curves

label: Battery cycles
description: Rated full charge cycles the maker states for this car's battery. Blank = the chemistry default (data/battery/chemistries.csv)

label: Source of the battery cycles
description: Id of the source in data/sources.csv. Blank = the chemistry default

label: Consumption of motors
description: From the same source and standard as the rated range. Blank = battery ÷ rated range

label: Rated range CLTC
description: Chinese test cycle

label: Rated range NEDC
description: New European Driving Cycle

label: Rated range WLTP
description: Worldwide harmonised procedure

label: Rated range EPA
description: US EPA label

label: Consumption standard
description: Only needed when ranges for several standards are given; otherwise taken from the filled range column

label: Charging test from
description: Published fast-charging figure, e.g. 10 → 80 % in 30 min

label: Fast charging starts at
description: Below this, charging runs at the reduced (taper) speed. Blank = charging test 'from'

label: Fast charging ends at
description: Above this, charging runs at the reduced (taper) speed. Blank = charging test 'to'

label: Drag coefficient (Cd)
description: Blank = body-type default

label: Frontal area
description: Blank = 0.85 × width × height, or body-type default

label: Width
description: Without mirrors

label: Curb weight
description: Without driver. EU figures (mass in running order) include a 75 kg driver: subtract it. Blank = estimated from battery size

label: Tyre rolling resistance
description: EU tyre label value (e.g. 7.0). Blank = assumption

label: Heat pump
description: yes = the cabin is heated by a heat pump (2–3× less power in mild cold), no = resistive heater only. Blank = no (resistive heater assumed). Only matters below about 15 °C

label: Power
description: HP is calculated (× 1.341)

label: ACC
description: Adaptive cruise control (yes / no)

label: Energy price override
description: Per kWh (or per litre for ICE) in the car's currency. Blank = the electricity price of the Cost page

label: Servicing override
description: Scheduled servicing per year in the car's currency. Blank = the market's value for the powertrain (data/running_costs.csv)

label: Insurance override
description: Voluntary (class-1) insurance per year in the car's currency, e.g. a quote. Blank = % of the car's value (data/running_costs.csv)

label: Tyre set price
description: Four tyres fitted, in the car's currency. Blank = the market's price for the car class (data/running_costs.csv)

label: Engine size
description: Petrol cars: engine displacement, for the road tax. Electric cars are taxed by weight

label: CO₂ emissions
description: Petrol cars: official CO₂ emissions (WLTP combined), for road taxes that depend on CO₂ (Germany: Kfz-Steuer above 95 g/km)

label: Last updated
description: Date of the last check of this row
